evidence.title: shadcn ui custom password input · GitHub

name: password-input.tsx
summary: Copy-paste shadcn/ui password input with a show/hide eye toggle, plus a sample signup-style form.
description: A single-file React/TypeScript PasswordInput for shadcn/ui: it wraps shadcn's Input and Button, uses lucide-react eye icons to toggle visibility, and hides the browser's native password-reveal button. The gist also includes a sample use case with current/new/confirm password fields. 186 stars, 14 forks, 9 revisions.
contains: uses shadcn/ui Input + Button and lucide-react icons
comment thread includes a shadcn-svelte port
